about: Item ratings for the Isaac bot (a careful, no-damage player). See ITEMS.md for how to use them.

scales.rating: 0 = avoid (hurts this bot), 1 = weak or mixed, 2 = fine, 3 = good, 4 = take it whenever offered
scales.carry: 0 = no effect on results, 1 = small, 2 = noticeable, 3 = big, 4 = huge, 5 = carries the run alone
scales.carried_run: flag a run as carried if any held item has carry >= 4, or the held items' carry adds up to >= 8
scales.unsure: true = the rating is a guess (missing description or unclear mechanic); test before trusting it

tag_glossary.ondmg: only works after taking damage (weak for a no-hit bot)
tag_glossary.atk: changes the attack (bot may need support)

auto_use_glossary.fight: press in a fight (boss or 3+ enemies)
auto_use_glossary.clear: after the room is cleared (pocket/trinket slot rules apply)
auto_use_glossary.manual: needs special code (two-step, aim or bomb timing); not with the plain button press
auto_use_glossary.never: never automatically (a Stage 4 decision or harmful)
